inputs.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is a full-body reference image of the subject.
<Picture 2> is an upper-body reference image of the subject.
<Picture 3> is a face close-up reference image of the subject.

<Subject 1> is the subject consistently defined by <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and <Picture 3>. Strictly preserve the facial features, hairstyle, eye appearance, skin tone, body proportions, and visual style shown in the reference images.
<Subject 2> is the clothing and attire shown in the reference images. Keep the outfit consistent with the references.
<Subject 3> is a standard slim handheld microphone.
<Subject 4> is a neutral, clean indoor studio environment with soft even lighting and low background detail.

summary:
[reference generation] <Subject 1> performs a short spoken-voice clarity test speaking into <Subject 3> while standing stably and facing the camera.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - strictly preserve the subject's identity, facial features, hair, eyes, skin tone, and proportions from the reference images. Do not copy unintended background details from the references.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - keep the attire consistent with the references.
<Subject 3> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - hold the microphone naturally near the mouth while speaking.
<Subject 4> (applies throughout [Shot 1]): attribute_transfer - maintain a quiet, neutral illustrated background with consistent lighting.

integrated_multimodal_description:
A clean, stable character voice and identity test shot. Keep the subject clearly visible with consistent features matching the reference images. Avoid erratic motion, rapid camera moves, sudden lighting shifts, or distracting background elements.

[Shot 1] <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a stable medium-close framing, wearing <Subject 2> and holding <Subject 3> close to their mouth. The camera remains fixed. The subject maintains eye contact with the camera, blinks naturally, and clearly articulates the spoken phrase: <d>[English] Peter picked a bright blue pepper. Silver stars shimmer through the night.</d>. The mouth, lips, jaw, and facial muscles articulate every syllable in precise sync with the generated speech. Body movement is kept subtle and natural to ensure voice clarity, audio fidelity, and lip synchronization are easy to evaluate.

overall_soundscape:
Clean dry studio ambience only. No crowd noise, no background chatter, no audible echo or reverb masking the voice.

non_diegetic_music:
None. No background music.
